_comment: 리워드 아이템 그림 작업 목록. 이미지 모델에 한 줄씩 넘긴다. 규격과 공통 프롬프트는 brief.md. targetBox는 기리 360 좌표계(viewBox -30 0 360 360)에서 그림이 들어갈 상자 [x1, y1, x2, y2]로, 생성 후 배치할 때 쓴다(reward-flow.md 8.2). 손 아이템의 targetBox는 쥐는 점 (0,0) 기준 아이템 자체 좌표다. kanaBoxes는 배경 그림에 합성할 가나와 그 자리(360 좌표계 정사각형 [x1, y1, x2, y2])로, 고른 그림의 노렌 자락에 맞춰 정했다. 그림을 바꾸면 다시 맞춘다.

items.prompt: A simple front view of a small Japanese eatery entrance: a dark indigo split noren curtain hanging across the top-left of a wooden doorway, light cream plaster wall, a little potted plant at the bottom-right edge. The center of the picture is a calm, very light, almost empty wall area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.

A single piece of nigiri sushi: an oval white rice block with a salmon slice draped on top, salmon in warm orange with light stripes. Viewed from slightly above, held upright as if pinched at its bottom center.

A small round wooden ohitsu rice tub with its flat wooden lid on, warm light wood with two thin dark copper hoop bands, short and wide, slightly tilted as if resting on top of a head like a little hat. Only the tub.

A small round bowl of kitsune udon seen from the front and slightly above: a dark indigo bowl, thick white udon noodles, a big golden-brown sheet of fried tofu (aburaage) on top, a couple of thin green-olive scallion rings. Upright, held from the bottom of the bowl.
A festival tasuki sash: a long, narrow indigo cloth band with a thin white edge line, running diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a small tied bow at the left end. Only the band.

A simple, completely empty Japanese train station platform with nobody on it: pale sky, a blank station name board on two short posts at the top-left, a yellow tactile line along the platform edge at the bottom, a bit of a train window at the right edge. The middle of the picture is just empty pale platform and sky. Leave the station name board blank with no letters.

A small rectangular Japanese train ticket, cream paper with a thin sky-blue band and a tiny punched hole, standing upright as if held at its bottom edge. No readable text, only two short abstract lines.

A simple shrine approach: a vermilion torii gate framing the picture with its top beam across the top and its two pillars at the left and right edges, a light stone path in the middle, soft green-grey shrubs at the bottom corners, pale sky. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area.

A cute white festival fox mask (kitsune omen) floating alone, front view tilted about 20 degrees: white face shape with pointed fox ears, simple orange-red markings, empty eye holes, a thin cord loop at the side. Only the flat mask itself, nothing behind or under it.

A twisted cloth headband (nejiri hachimaki) shown alone as a flat object, front view: a thick rope-like band made of only two colors, dark indigo blue and white, twisted together in a spiral, bent into a wide shallow upward arc like a smile (not a closed ring), with a small knot and two short tails at the right end. Only indigo and white, no other colors.

A Japanese shop apron (maekake): a thick indigo canvas apron with a plain cream waist band tied across, front view, short and wide. A simple circle emblem with no letters in the middle. Only the apron.

A simple bathhouse entrance: an indigo noren curtain hanging at the top-left, warm wooden frame, a light wooden floor and a pair of small sandals at the bottom-right edge, faint soft steam curls. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.
A small folded tenugui hand towel lying flat, front view: white cotton with a simple indigo wave pattern, folded into a neat flat rectangle, slightly tilted. Only the folded towel, nothing under it.

A long folded furoshiki cloth worn like a neckerchief, shown alone as a flat object: a plum purple band with a light swirl pattern running diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a simple square knot and two short pointed ends at the left. Only the purple cloth, one color.

A small round wooden plate with one rectangular slice of dark red-brown yokan (sweet bean jelly) on it and a little bamboo pick stuck in the slice. Only the plate and the yokan on the plain gray background: no balls, no circles, no dots, no other food, nothing behind them.
